topics.label: Introduction and the Hallmarks of Cancer Framework
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining learning objectives, previous lecture context, and the general framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Evasion of Growth Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream signaling cascades enable cancer cells to sustain proliferation and overcome inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells undergo a block in terminal differentiation, illustrating the process across hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and the dysregulation of apoptotic regulators.

topics.label: Senescence and Replicative Immortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how telomere shortening and cellular stress trigger protective senescence, and how cancer cells bypass these mechanisms to achieve replicative immortality.

topics.label: Deregulating Cellular Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce systemic tumor adaptations and examine how cancer cells rewire their metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, Krebs cycle mutations, and oncometabolites.

topics.label: Inducing Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain why expanding tumors require new vasculature, the timing of vascularisation during tumor progression, and the balance of signals controlling the angiogenic switch.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the biological steps, circulatory dynamics, diagnostic markers, and clonal origins of cancer metastasis.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary of how hallmarks interact, concluding advice on review literature, and practical announcements.
